summary: Robert Jacobs, 65, missing after leaving Castle Rock at 4 p.m. on his black Harley-Davidson Road King motorcycle en route to Breckenridge and never arriving; DCSO conducted several extensive ground and helicopter searches without success; on 2015-06-27 a passerby reported a body in the South Platte River near Waterton Canyon — Douglas and Jefferson County SOs, the Douglas County Coroner, and West/South Metro Fire recovered it and the coroner identified him as Jacobs; his motorcycle (CO plate 445UVU) was later pulled from the river ~2 mi north of Sugar Creek Road; detectives believe he ran off the gravel road into the river, no foul play suspected
location: South Platte River near Waterton Canyon
responding_agency: Douglas County Sheriff's Office; Jefferson County Sheriff's Office; West and South Metro Fire Rescue; Douglas County Coroner's Office
notes: Date recorded at the missing/search date (2015-06-08, a Monday) per convention; body found and recovered 2015-06-27; motorcycle recovered later; road near the accident site was gravel at the time
